messages:
elena: Heads up - onboarding hit: async py client -> Dedicated endpoint behind corporate proxy throws CERT_VERIFY. Sync client fine.
samir: Exact error?
elena: `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate`
elena: Env they set: REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://private.rdwd.internal HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128 REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/org-ca.pem using redwood.AsyncClient() from sdk 0.13.0
anika: Do they pass a proxy param in code? We renamed kwarg from `proxy` to `http_proxy` in 0.13 and kept an alias for sync-only; async still accepts `proxy` in the transport internals. Could be a mismatch and codepath falls back to env handling which doesn't load custom cafile.
elena: They didn't set any kwarg, relying on env only. curl + --proxy + --cacert works.
marcus: Repro path: create SSLContext with cafile and pass to aiohttp TCPConnector when using proxy. aiohttp requires the ssl context for tunneled connections or it will use default cert store.
samir: Quick repro script I used: ```python
import ssl, aiohttp, asyncio
ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/certs/org-ca.pem')
async def main():
    conn = aiohttp.TCPConnector(ssl=ssl_ctx)
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession(connector=conn) as s:
        async with s.get('https://private.rdwd.internal', proxy='http://proxy.corp:3128') as r:
            print(r.status)
asyncio.run(main())
```
elena: Reproduces. Workaround: instantiate AsyncClient with explicit ssl argument: ```python
import ssl
from redwood import AsyncClient
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/certs/org-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://private.rdwd.internal', http_proxy='http://proxy.corp:3128', ssl=ctx)
```
anika: Two follow-ups: (1) the public API docs don't mention `ssl=` on AsyncClient (we exposed it but failed to document), (2) env vars REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE / SSL_CERT_FILE should be respected automatically across sync+async.
marcus: Also noticed typing mismatch: AsyncClient stubs show `proxy: Optional[str]` but runtime accepts `http_proxy`. This confuses mypy and autocompletion.
samir: Action items: add unit test for proxy+custom-ca for async transport; update AsyncTransport to check SSL_CERT_FILE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and load into context when building connector; fix the typing alias so kwarg names are consistent and update stubs; add docs snippet for Dedicated onboarding (custom CA + proxy).
anika: I'll open PR for typing + docs. Marcus will add the CI test. Samir will patch transport.
ops-bot: Created issue #5910 "py-sdk: async client should honor REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and expose consistent proxy/ssl typing" and linked this thread.
elena: Thanks team. For support reply: ask for curl --proxy --cacert output and suggest explicit ssl context instantiation for immediate workaround. :+1:
